Workshops tailored to the group, from field teams to research students, and available in several languages.

::: {.cards}

::: {.card-item}
### Soil classification
Describing and classifying soils in the field with WRB and national systems, using our free classification keys.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Digital soil mapping
From covariates and sampling to predictions and their uncertainty.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Data harmonisation
Combining legacy and new data across depths, methods and surveys.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Uncertainty and R
Quantifying, propagating and communicating uncertainty, with reproducible workflows in R.
:::
